description.fun: Elekid gets rowdy at the sound of a coming thunderstorm and loves to play right in the middle of one. It makes electricity by spinning its arms round and round, but it tires quickly and can't store the charge, so it sneaks into people's homes to feed on electricity from the sockets, which serve as its baby bottles. The horns on its head are shaped like the prongs of a power plug.
description.guide: A small, yellow Electric baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2, with black stripes and two horns shaped like the prongs of a plug. It makes electricity by spinning its arms but tires easily. It evolves into Electabuzz, which evolves into Electivire.
description.tagline: A plug-headed baby that feeds from wall sockets

description.fun: Electabuzz leaks more electricity than it uses, so it glows blue in the dark and makes your hair stand on end if you get too close. Groups gather around tall trees to wait for storms, then compete for the spots most likely to be struck by lightning, and people use it in place of lightning rods. It often gets the blame for power cuts, though the electric company is more often at fault.
description.guide: A yellow, black-striped Electric Pokémon with antennae on its head, the evolution of Elekid. It gives off constant electricity, absorbs lightning unharmed and lives near power plants. It evolves into Electivire when traded holding an Electirizer, and seems to be based on the oni of Japanese folklore.
description.tagline: A living lightning rod that glows in the dark

description.fun: Electivire is said to put out more electrical energy than any other Electric Pokémon: a single one could power a large city for a whole year. The tips of its two cable-like tails shock with over 20,000 volts, and it grips them to charge up its punches. When it gets excited it thumps its chest, sending thunder and sparks flying. The pattern on its back looks like a power socket.
description.guide: The final form of Elekid, a large, yellow and black Electric Pokémon introduced in Generation 4. It evolves from Electabuzz when traded holding an Electirizer, and it has two cable-like tails and a socket-shaped pattern on its back. It is said to have the greatest electrical output of all Electric Pokémon.
description.tagline: Enough power for a city, wired into its punches

note.text: Elekid is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Electabuzz it grows into.
